spans.text: At one time the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.

entries.description: Venerable Mahākoṭṭhita came out of retreat
entries.subject: Venerable Mahākoṭṭhita

spans.text: Then in the late afternoon, Venerable Mahākoṭṭhita came out of retreat, went to Venerable Sāriputta, and exchanged greetings with him.

entries.description: What is the goal of wisdom?”
entries.subject: What

spans.text: “What is the goal of wisdom?”
“The goal of wisdom is direct knowledge, complete understanding, and giving up.”

entries.task_id: right view|is|supported by how many factors does it have freedom of heart and freedom by wisdom as its fruit and benefit?”
entries.description: right view is supported by how many factors does it have freedom of heart and freedom by wisdom as its fruit and benefit?”
entries.subject: right view
entries.object: supported by how many factors does it have freedom of heart and freedom by wisdom as its fruit and benefit?”

spans.text: “When right view is supported by how many factors does it have freedom of heart and freedom by wisdom as its fruit and benefit?”
“When right view is supported by five factors it has freedom of heart and freedom by wisdom as its fruit and benefit.
It’s when right view is supported by ethics, learning, discussion, serenity, and discernment.
When right view is supported by these five factors it has freedom of heart and freedom by wisdom as its fruit and benefit.”

entries.description: How is a witless person defined?”
entries.subject: How

spans.text: How is a witless person defined?”
They don’t understand: ‘This is suffering’ …
‘This is the origin of suffering’ …
‘This is the cessation of suffering’ …
‘This is the practice that leads to the cessation of suffering.’
